name: Truth Of God The
overview: The truth of God is revealed as an unchanging and faithful attribute, demonstrated in His merciful guidance and fulfillment of promises to His people, as seen in His dealings with Abraham and Jacob. Scripture affirms that God is not like man who lies or repents, but He always does what He has spoken, making His truth a reliable shield and source of deliverance for the saints. His truth is abundant, enduring through all generations, and is intimately connected with His justice, covenant faithfulness, and gracious character.
